results.name: Super Tool Automotive Inc.
results.notes: Site live at supertoolauto.com; AAA Approved listing and Birdeye profile both active, so status holds. Checked in browser: /Auto-Repair/Schedule-My-Service is a two-choice date/time request form with reCAPTCHA present, text explicitly says the chosen time is not guaranteed and staff reply within 24 hours - confirmed. Homepage has exactly one JSON-LD block, an Organization stub with name/logo/alternateName only, no LocalBusiness, hours, geo or aggregateRating - confirmed. /Reviews page shows no ratings or review text, only 'READ OUR GOOGLE REVIEWS' and 'LEAVE US A REVIEW ON SURECRITIC' links - confirmed. Site hours Mon-Fri 8:00-5:30, Sat/Sun closed; AAA shop page and Birdeye both list 9:00-6:00 Mon-Fri - the stated inconsistency is real. robots.txt re-read: wildcard group allows search bots plus explicit allow groups for Claude-User/ChatGPT-User/Google-Agent, blocks Bytespider/Amazonbot/Diffbot/Meta-ExternalAgent - matches. Birdeye shows 4.7 with 123 reviews. Scores look fair: narrow but real gaps on a decent template site, established 1996 business with fleet/Penske revenue, evidence directly observed.

results.notes: Status holds: site live, 197 GlossGenius reviews embedded (review carousel reads 1/197), HairSalon JSON-LD present with a real postal address (407 Raritan Ave, Highland Park NJ 08904), prices and deposits in text ($50 deposit for fashion color, $60 for single process, $120-150 service prices). results.name: Reboot It Tech Service - South River
results.notes: Site live at rebootitnj.com (single Google Sites page). Confirmed in browser: no phone number and no tel: or sms: links anywhere on the page; page text says text is the best contact and that it is 'a one-woman show' and a part-time business alongside a full-time job, established 2017, appointment-only home-office with pickup/drop-off; service-area list matches the record exactly. Booking button links to form.jotform.com/rebootit.nj/appointmentform and the cited form ID https://form.jotform.com/222208234519047 still loads with the title 'Reboot It Appointment Request + Repair & Service Agreement and Liability Waiver', so the paperwork-per-job signal holds; that form carries the phone 732-955-4789, which is how the number exists without being on the site. Review base of 4.9 from 19 reviews is corroborated by a BestProsInTown listing for the same business. Scores gap 3 / ability 2 / ease 4 / evidence 4 remain reasonable - the work is real but low-value for a part-time owner.

results.name: Globo Auto BMW Specialist
results.notes: Everything checked holds. Home page has JSON-LD of type ['AutoRepair','LocalBusiness'] with street address 190 William St #1C, telephone +1-732-387-2281, openingHoursSpecification Mon-Fri 10:00-20:00 and sameAs instagram; four tel:+17323872281 links plus 'WALK-INS WELCOME' / 'NO APPOINTMENT NEEDED'. /contact has one form with fields name, phone, email, vehicle, service, message and no action/method attribute and no onsubmit handler, so delivery is unproven without submitting - as recorded. robots.txt is Cloudflare-managed: User-agent: * Allow: /, with Disallow for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Claude-Web, Google-Extended, anthropic-ai, CCBot, Bytespider and others - matches. Google Maps panel showed 4.9 with 278 reviews, category 'Auto repair shop', open until 8 PM, services section listing only instagram.com, an explicit 'Add website' prompt under 'Add missing information', and owner photos 27 days old - so the missing-website and recent-owner-activity claims are both correct. Gap 2, ability 4, ease 3, evidence 4 are reasonable - the remaining gap is narrow but the GBP website field is a real, cheap win for a shop with 278 reviews and high-ticket build work.

results.name: R.A. Nichols Home Services (R.A. Nichols Plumbing, Heating & Air)
results.notes: Confirmed with one nuance. Google Maps: 4.9 / 734 reviews, category Plumber, 13 Lake Ave Helmetta, 'Open 24 hours', website link, phone (732) 896-2821, Book online action, owner post 4 days ago - all as recorded. Site: JSON-LD @graph with ['LocalBusiness','Plumber','HVACBusiness'], licence numbers and 24/7 emergency text; every visible 'Book Online' anchor is href='#' (the ServiceTitan scheduler is JS-injected), confirmed. robots.txt explicitly allows GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-User and PerplexityBot - confirmed. The contact page has a 'Business Hours' block whose only content is '24/7 Emergency Service', so no actual opening hours are published - the claim holds, though the site does imply around-the-clock availability. Helmetta service-area page images carry Monroe Township alt text - confirmed verbatim. Phone spread: visible site numbers are all (732) 927-1945 today, GBP shows (732) 896-2821, and the site's own JSON-LD lists telephone +16096403394; the (609) 640-3394 number survives only in the page's React payload as tel:6096403394 links that no longer render visibly. Birdeye confirms 4.9 from 895 reviews on an unclaimed profile with 7:30-4 hours, so the GBP vs Birdeye vs site hours conflict is real. No prices on the home page except a '$50 off drain cleaning' coupon, so 'no price ranges or diagnostic fee' holds. Scores gap 2 / ability 4 / ease 3 / evidence 4 are reasonable.

The front-desk job posting is live at $20-30/hr with duties covering calls, scheduling, insurance verification and claims. Only the form-label claim failed, so gap 2 and ability 4 stand, but evidence drops to 3 because one of the three top issues was misdescribed.
